verdict.rationale: Vast.ai ships an official `vastai` CLI. The docs describe it as covering the whole platform: authentication, GPU search, instance lifecycle, templates, volumes, serverless and scoped API keys, with concrete command examples and an end-to-end workflow. It is backed by the official vast-ai/vast-cli GitHub repo and a probe-confirmed CLI docs page. The AI-native angle is covered by the `vastai` agent skill, which lets AI coding assistants drive the platform, and by the shell/Python parity. missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of CLI usage.
